components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber pill; one per page (npm link on product pages).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #f0b429); color: #0a0a0c; font: 600 0.875rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f6c555; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0b429); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline pill for secondary actions (github link).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); background: transparent; color: #ededf0; font: 500 0.875rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 140ms, border-color 140ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--accent, #f0b429); border-color: var(--accent, #f0b429); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0b429); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Install Row
components.description: Signature pair: command box + right-aligned copy pill, 12px apart.
components.css: .ds-install { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: stretch; } .ds-cmd { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; overflow-x: auto; white-space: nowrap; background: #0e0e11; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 6px; color: #ededf0; font: 0.8125rem/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-copy { flex: none; margin-left: auto; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); background: transparent; color: #a3a3ad; font: 500 0.78125rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms, border-color 140ms; } .ds-copy:hover, .ds-copy:focus-visible { color: var(--accent, #f0b429); border-color: var(--accent, #f0b429); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0b429); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet dark console: near-black field, hairline-grid cards, and a single amber phosphor accent reserved for the pulse mark, focus, and primary actions. System typeset only; the register is offrouter.com / here.now.
keyCharacteristics: One amber accent rationed to signals

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber never fills regions larger than a button, never tints body copy, never glows.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans speaks to humans, mono speaks to shells.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation from 1px hairlines and tonal steps, never shadows or colored edges.

dos: Do keep text/background pairs at WCAG AA or better
Do reuse tokens and components verbatim on new pages
donts: Don't add gradients, glows, shadows, blur, or a second hue
Don't use mono for non-command text
Don't place the copy control flush against command text
Don't add eyebrows to every section
